blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon. The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte has linked an alleged threat against a former household staff member to the Marcos administration. Meanwhile, three areas in the country are expected to experience dangerous heat indices on Tuesday, Nov. 17, according to the state weather bureau. In entertainment, P-pop groups Bini and SB19 made history after earning nominations at the 2027 Grammy Awards, becoming the first Filipino acts nominated in the Best Asian Pop Music Performance category./dp READ: Bini earns historic win at Nickelodeon Kids Choice Awards...
